tools.name: get_my_courses
tools.description: List the student's active Google Classroom classes with their IDs.

tools.name: get_todo
tools.description: Everything assigned that the student has not turned in yet. Pass course_ids to limit it, or leave empty for all active classes.

tools.name: get_upcoming_due_dates
tools.description: Work that is due soon and not turned in, soonest first. Pass course_ids or days_ahead to narrow it, or leave both empty.

tools.name: get_missing_assignments
tools.description: Past due work that has not been turned in. Pass course_ids to limit it, or leave empty for all active classes.

tools.name: get_assignments
tools.description: Assignments for one class with due dates and status.

tools.name: get_my_grades
tools.description: Grades on returned work for each class. Google Classroom has no overall grade, so this adds up graded work only. Pass course_ids to limit it, or leave empty for all active classes.

tools.name: get_announcements
tools.description: Recent announcements. Pass course_ids to limit it, or leave empty for all active classes.
